name: Flame Consumption
description: Accursed surrounds himself with a powerful fire tornado, dispelling debuffs and converting 100% of all incoming damage into Health gained for the duration.

source.notes: From hon_reborn_slice.json. Instant cast (casttime=0). No mana cost. Dispels StatusDebuff and StatusDisable on self. Applies State_Accursed_Ability4 for 3000/4000/5000ms. State converts all damage taken to healing (absorbdamage equivalent). Cooldown 60000ms (flat, all 3 levels). Max level 3, required_level 6/11/16.

adapted.adaptation_reason: Cooldown: ceil(60s / 5s) = 12 turns — the longest cooldown in either kit, reflects this is Accursed's panic button. Duration: ceil(3s / 5s) = 1 turn minimum. Energy cost 0 — kept as designed. Dispel on cast: removes all Stun + Debuffs. During the buff turn: all damage received is converted to healing (100% damage-to-heal). This is potentially very strong in the card game since an entire turn of attacks could be nullified — balance risk HIGH. Test scenario I (extreme interactions). Consider duration = 0.5 turn (partial turn) or limit to one attack's worth of conversion.
